title: Portable native elliptic L-function boundary
objective: Expose eclib root numbers and implement a host-independent batched FLINT/Arb central-derivative accelerator with Node adapter and native tests

exceptions: Arb foreign-library adapter and compact batched numerical primitive; the readable mathematics and dynamic fallback live in ordinary Python

handoff.summary: Commits 5a43cbff and 7d89428e expose eclib global root numbers and a portable C/FLINT-Arb completed central-Lambda derivative jet through ecRootNumber and ecCompletedCentralDerivatives. The jet returns consecutive actual derivatives with exact functional-equation parity, decimal arithmetic-ball diagnostics, explicit coefficient/resource status, and separate n>K and variable-K_j grid-omission bounds. The Molin K_j optimization reduces the motivating 64-bit kernel from 415072 to 49727 coefficient terms (4.065 ms warm median) and the 88-bit kernel from 745254 to 85031 terms (6.293 ms). Focused native tests cover the geometric bound, canonical normalization, ranks 0/1/2, rational Q-isomorphic models, insufficient coefficients, and oversized conductors.
risks: The Arb balls enclose arithmetic rounding only. tailBound is the sum of coefficientTailBound and gridOmissionBound, while the unproved trapezoid/grid discretization error means rigorous is deliberately false; the Python layer must use precision/grid stability checks and add tailBound to the arithmetic radius.

Windows x64, macOS arm64, and Linux arm64 runtime receipts remain pending. The implementation uses the existing C17/Node-API/FLINT build path and avoids POSIX-only APIs; the integration lane will validate Windows once the shared checkout is free.

pnpm test:portable fails only because architecture/native-code inventory metrics for packages/flint/src/addon.c are stale after this lane's export additions. This lane was explicitly told not to edit architecture inventories.
K_j is planned from binary64 Molin parameters, matching PARI's practical construction but remaining part of the explicitly non-rigorous analytic discretization.
next_steps: Integration lane: classify the new native ABI/kernel and refresh architecture inventory metrics, then rerun pnpm test:portable and pnpm architecture:check.
Integration lane: run the focused native test and build on Windows x64, macOS arm64, and Linux arm64 and record receipts.

Math lane: add the aggregate tailBound (not its diagnostic components again) to the arithmetic radius, retain the non-rigorous status, and perform completed-to-raw gamma convolution in ordinary Python.
After integration, run the full pnpm test:native and pnpm test:sea suites; this lane's cold dependency rebuilds were interrupted to avoid delaying the committed handoff.
